params.prompt: A frame grabbed from a Korean sitcom video, 9:16 vertical: candid mid-action, caught between movements, slight natural motion softness on the hands, not a posed photo. Evening living room (warm lamps, string lights, arched window dark navy), fixed tripod camera at eye level, natural skin, no beauty filter, no text, no watermark. Keep the exact face, hair, glasses and clothes of the people in the reference images and the exact room. Medium shot at the island: the man (29, Korean, round gold wire glasses, jet-black two-block hair, navy overshirt open over a white T-shirt, company ID badge on a navy lanyard, grey trousers) standing, offering his phone to the woman (27, Filipino-American, warm golden-tan skin, long dark wavy hair with curtain bangs, white poplin shirt with cuffed sleeves, dark-indigo jeans, small gold hoops, no glasses) with both hands like handing in homework, head slightly bowed, eyes peeking up at her; she, on the stool, looks at the phone then at him, deadpan, mid-sigh.
